+        that means the framing never reached us (``skip_special_tokens`` was on,
+        or the chunk carrying the header was dropped upstream), and scanning
+        everything is strictly better than returning nothing.
+        """
+        bodies = [
+            body
+            for rcpt, body, _closed in _iter_messages(text)
+            if rcpt is not None and rcpt not in cls._non_tool_recipients
+        ]
+        if bodies:
+            return "\n".join(bodies)
+        if _MSG_HEADER_RE.search(text) is None and (
+            _FUNCTION_CALLS_OPEN in text or "<atem:invoke" in text
+        ):
+            logger.warning(
+                "Muse: ATEM markup with no channel framing; "
+                "is skip_special_tokens enabled upstream?"
+            )
+            return text
+        return ""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _visible_channels(cls, text: str) -> tuple[str, str, bool, bool]:
+        """Return ``(content, reasoning, content_open, reasoning_open)``.
+
+        The ``*_open`` flags say whether that channel's LAST message is still
+        being generated; only then must the caller hold back a partial
+        structural marker. Tracking them per channel matters: a closed
+        reasoning block whose text happens to end in ``<`` would otherwise stay
+        permanently truncated while a later content message is open.
+        """
+        content_parts: list[str] = []
+        reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
+        content_open = False
+        reasoning_open = False
+        for rcpt, body, closed in _iter_messages(text):
+            if rcpt in cls._reasoning_recipients:
+                reasoning_parts.append(body)
+                reasoning_open = not closed
+            elif rcpt in cls._content_recipients:
+                content_parts.append(body)
+                content_open = not closed
+        return (
+            "".join(content_parts),
+            "".join(reasoning_parts),
+            content_open,
+            reasoning_open,
+        )
+
+    # ---------------- tool name binding ----------------
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _registered_names(request: ChatCompletionRequest | None) -> set[str]:
+        """Names of the tools the client registered on this request."""
+        names: set[str] = set()
+        tools = getattr(request, "tools", None) if request is not None else None
+        for t in tools or []:
+            fn = getattr(t, "function", None) or t
+            name = getattr(fn, "name", None)
+            if name is None and isinstance(fn, dict):
+                name = fn.get("name")
+            if name:
+                names.add(name)
+        return names
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _string_parameters(
+        cls, request: ChatCompletionRequest | ResponsesRequest | None
+    ) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
+        if not cls._preserve_string_parameters:
+            return {}
+        strings: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+        for tool in getattr(request, "tools", None) or []:
+            function = getattr(tool, "function", None) or tool
+            if isinstance(function, dict):
+                name = function.get("name")
+                parameters = function.get("parameters")
+            else:
+                name = getattr(function, "name", None)
+                parameters = getattr(function, "parameters", None)
+            if name and isinstance(parameters, dict):
+                strings[name] = {
+                    key
+                    for key, schema in parameters.get("properties", {}).items()
+                    if isinstance(schema, dict) and schema.get("type") == "string"
+                }
+        return strings
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _normalize_name(emitted: str, registered: set[str]) -> str:
+        """Map an emitted ATEM invoke name back to a registered tool name.
+
+        When a client registers a BARE name (e.g. ``get_weather``) the shipped
+        chat template renders the valid recipient as ``"get_weather.*"``, and
+        the model duly emits ``get_weather.get_weather``. Collapsing that
+        doubled form is safe: head and tail are identical and the collapsed
+        name is registered.
+
+        Anything else is passed through unchanged. Matching on the trailing
+        segment alone is NOT safe -- an emitted ``weather.get`` against a
+        registered ``{calendar.get}`` has a unique leaf match and would silently
+        dispatch the wrong tool.
+        """
+        if not registered or emitted in registered:
+            return emitted
+        head, sep, tail = emitted.partition(".")
+        if sep and head == tail and head in registered:
+            return head
+        logger.warning(
+            "Muse: emitted tool name %r does not match any registered tool; "
+            "passing through unchanged.",
+            emitted,
+        )
+        return emitted
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _parse_tool_calls(
+        cls,
+        text: str,
+        registered: set[str] | None = None,
+        strings: dict[str, set[str]] | None = None,
+    ) -> list[ToolCall]:
+        registered = registered or set()
+        scoped = cls._tool_channel_text(text)
+        tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = []
+        for invoke in _INVOKE_RE.findall(scoped):
+            name_m = _NAME_RE.search(invoke)
+            if not name_m:
+                continue
+            name = cls._normalize_name(name_m.group(1), registered)
+            string_parameters = (strings or {}).get(name, set())
+            args: dict = {}
+            for pm in _PARAM_RE.finditer(invoke):
+                key, raw = pm.group("key"), pm.group("value")
+                args[key] = raw if key in string_parameters else _decode_value(raw)
+            tool_calls.append(
+                ToolCall(
+                    function=FunctionCall(
+                        name=name,
+                        arguments=json.dumps(args, ensure_ascii=False),
+                    )
+                )
+            )
+        return tool_calls
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _extract_content(cls, text: str) -> str | None:
+        """Return the user-facing body, or the raw text when unframed."""
+        content, reasoning, _c_open, _r_open = cls._visible_channels(text)
+        if content:
+            return content
+        # No framing at all -> the whole thing is plain content.
+        if not reasoning and _MSG_HEADER_RE.search(text) is None:
+            return text or None
+        return None
+
+    # ---------------- non-streaming ----------------
+
+    def extract_tool_calls(
+        self, model_output: str, request: ChatCompletionRequest
+    ) -> ExtractedToolCallInformation:
+        if (
+            _FUNCTION_CALLS_OPEN not in model_output
+            and "<atem:invoke" not in model_output
+        ):
+            return ExtractedToolCallInformation(
+                tools_called=False,
+                tool_calls=[],
+                content=self._extract_content(model_output),
+            )
+        try:
+            registered = self._registered_names(request)
+            tool_calls = self._parse_tool_calls(
+                model_output, registered, self._string_parameters(request)
+            )
+            if not tool_calls:
+                # A tool block was opened but no COMPLETE
+                # <atem:invoke>...</atem:invoke> parsed -- typically a truncated
+                # call (finish_reason='length'/abort). Log it: silently
+                # returning "no tool call" here is indistinguishable from the
+                # model choosing not to call one, which makes this failure mode
+                # invisible in production.
+                logger.warning(
+                    "Muse: tool channel opened but no complete <atem:invoke> "
+                    "parsed (truncated tool call?); returning content only."
+                )
+                return ExtractedToolCallInformation(
+                    tools_called=False,
+                    tool_calls=[],
+                    content=self._extract_content(model_output),
+                )
+            return ExtractedToolCallInformation(
+                tools_called=True,
+                tool_calls=tool_calls,
+                content=self._extract_content(model_output),
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            logger.exception("Error extracting Muse ATEM tool calls.")
+            return ExtractedToolCallInformation(
+                tools_called=False, tool_calls=[], content=model_output
+            )
+
+    # ---------------- streaming ----------------
+
+    def extract_tool_calls_streaming(
+        self,
+        previous_text: str,
+        current_text: str,
+        delta_text: str,
+        previous_token_ids: Sequence[int],
+        current_token_ids: Sequence[int],
+        delta_token_ids: Sequence[int],
+        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+    ) -> DeltaMessage | None:
+        """Incremental ATEM streaming for tool calls AND content.
+
+        This parser owns every delta once reasoning has ended: in
+        vllm/parser/abstract_parser.py::parse_delta the "pass through as
+        content" fallback is guarded by ``not self._in_tool_call_phase(state)``,
+        and ``_in_tool_call_phase`` is simply ``tool_parser is not None and
+        state.reasoning_ended``. So with a tool parser loaded that fallback is
+        dead code, and returning None here DISCARDS the delta. Anything we do
+        not emit -- including the ``to=user`` final answer -- never reaches the
+        client. Hence content is emitted here, not left to the reasoning parser.
+
+        Tool calls are surfaced only when an ``<atem:invoke>`` block becomes
+        complete: the XML is opaque until closed and Muse parameters are not
+        incremental JSON, so there is nothing meaningful to stream before then.
+        """
+        if not previous_text:
+            # First delta of the tool phase (parse_delta resets previous_text
+            # to "" when it hands the stream over). Reset the cursors.
+            self._streamed_content_len = 0
+            self._streamed_reasoning_len = 0
+            self._emitted_tool_calls = 0
+
+        try:
+            registered = self._registered_names(request)
+            calls = self._parse_tool_calls(
+                current_text, registered, self._string_parameters(request)
+            )
+            content, reasoning, content_open, reasoning_open = self._visible_channels(
+                current_text
+            )
+
+            # Trim the tail of a channel that is still growing, so the emitted
+            # prefix never shrinks between deltas.
+            if content_open:
+                content = _safe_open_body(content)
+            if reasoning_open:
+                reasoning = _safe_open_body(reasoning)
+
+            content_delta = content[self._streamed_content_len :]
+            reasoning_delta = reasoning[self._streamed_reasoning_len :]
+
+            tool_deltas: list[DeltaToolCall] = []
+            for i in range(self._emitted_tool_calls, len(calls)):
+                fn = calls[i].function
+                tool_deltas.append(
+                    DeltaToolCall(
+                        index=i,
+                        type="function",
+                        id=make_tool_call_id(),
+                        function=DeltaFunctionCall(
+                            name=fn.name,
+                            arguments=fn.arguments,
+                        ).model_dump(exclude_none=True),
+                    )
+                )
+
+            if not content_delta and not reasoning_delta and not tool_deltas:
+                return None
+
+            self._streamed_content_len = len(content)
+            self._streamed_reasoning_len = len(reasoning)
+            self._emitted_tool_calls = len(calls)
+
+            message = DeltaMessage()
+            if content_delta:
+                message.content = content_delta
+            if reasoning_delta:
+                message.reasoning = reasoning_delta
+            if tool_deltas:
+                message.tool_calls = tool_deltas
+            return message
+        except Exception:
+            logger.exception("Error extracting Muse ATEM streaming tool calls.")
+            return None

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Construct Beam from a synthetic config and generate with dummy weights.
+
+Exercises NoPE + SSMax, hybrid sliding-window attention, the sigmoid output
+gate and its per-head bias, sandwich norm, depth-scaled residuals, grouped
+sigmoid routing, and logit softcapping without downloading a checkpoint.
+"""
+
+import json
+from operator import attrgetter
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
+from vllm.models.beam.nvidia import model as beam
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.beam import BeamConfig
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.eagle3_utils import (
+    set_eagle3_aux_hidden_state_layers,
+)
+
+# `moe_intermediate_size` must be a multiple of 128 for the BF16 MoE kernel.
+TINY_CONFIG = {
+    "architectures": ["BeamForCausalLM"],
+    "model_type": "beam",
+    "vocab_size": 1024,
+    "hidden_size": 128,
+    "intermediate_size": 256,
+    "num_hidden_layers": 2,
+    "num_attention_heads": 8,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 2,
+    "head_dim": 16,
+    "max_position_embeddings": 512,
+    "rms_norm_eps": 1e-6,
+    "sliding_window": 128,
+    "moe_intermediate_size": 256,
+    "num_experts_per_tok": 2,
+    "num_experts": 8,
+    "n_group": 2,
+    "topk_group": 1,
+    "routed_scaling_factor": 1.0,
+    "norm_topk_prob": True,
+    # Layer 1 is NoPE, so it takes the SSMax path and full attention while
+    # layer 0 stays RoPE + sliding. Exercises both branches in one model.
+    "layer_types": ["sliding_attention", "full_attention"],
+    "rope_parameters": {
+        "sliding_attention": {"rope_type": "default", "rope_theta": 10000.0},
+        "full_attention": None,
+    },
+    "mlp_layer_types": ["dense", "sparse"],
+    "final_logit_softcapping": 30.0,
+    "torch_dtype": "bfloat16",
+    "bos_token_id": 1,
+    "eos_token_id": 2,
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="Beam targets CUDA")
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("enable_pickle")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "enforce_eager,tp_size,num_experts,enable_ep",
+    [
+        (True, 1, 8, False),
+        (False, 1, 8, False),
+        (True, 4, 2, False),
+        (True, 4, 8, True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_beam_builds_and_generates(
+    tmp_path, enforce_eager, tp_size, num_experts, enable_ep
+):
+    """Release-style metadata must load and generate in both execution modes."""
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < tp_size:
+        pytest.skip(f"Requires {tp_size} GPUs")
+    config = {
+        **TINY_CONFIG,
+        "num_experts": num_experts,
+        "moe_intermediate_size": max(256, 128 * tp_size),
+        "n_group": 1 if num_experts == 2 else 2,
+    }
+    (tmp_path / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(config))
+
+    llm = LLM(
+        model=str(tmp_path),
+        load_format="dummy",
+        skip_tokenizer_init=True,
+        max_model_len=256,
+        max_num_seqs=1,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=256,
+        kv_cache_memory_bytes=16 * 1024**2,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.25,
+        enforce_eager=enforce_eager,
+        tensor_parallel_size=tp_size,
+        enable_expert_parallel=enable_ep,
+    )
+    outputs = llm.generate(
+        {"prompt_token_ids": [5, 6, 7, 8]},
+        SamplingParams(max_tokens=8, ignore_eos=True),
+    )
+
+    assert len(outputs[0].outputs[0].token_ids) == 8
+    # TP shards every expert; only EP partitions the expert set across ranks.
+    local_experts = num_experts // tp_size if enable_ep else num_experts
+    assert llm.apply_model(attrgetter("num_local_physical_experts")) == (
+        [local_experts] * tp_size
+    )
+
+
+def test_eplb_is_rejected_until_validated(monkeypatch):
+    """Expert parallelism is validated; expert rebalancing is not."""
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(hf_config=BeamConfig()),
+        quant_config=None,
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_eplb=True, use_sequence_parallel_moe=False
+        ),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="EPLB"):
+        beam.BeamForCausalLM(vllm_config=config)
+
+
+def test_sequence_parallel_moe_is_rejected_until_validated():
+    """DP attention with EP MoE takes the sequence-parallel path; unvalidated."""
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(hf_config=BeamConfig()),
+        quant_config=None,
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_eplb=False, use_sequence_parallel_moe=True
+        ),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="sequence-parallel"):
+        beam.BeamForCausalLM(vllm_config=config)
+
+
+def test_dense_only_pipeline_stage_initializes(monkeypatch):
+    """A stage with dense layers and remote MoE layers needs no local experts."""
+    layer = beam.BeamDecoderLayer.__new__(beam.BeamDecoderLayer)
+    nn.Module.__init__(layer)
+    layer.mlp = nn.Identity()
+    stage = nn.Module()
+    stage.layers = nn.ModuleList([layer, beam.PPMissingLayer()])
+    stage.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = lambda *args, **kwargs: None
+    monkeypatch.setattr(beam, "BeamModel", lambda **kwargs: stage)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        beam, "get_pp_group", lambda: SimpleNamespace(is_last_rank=False)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(beam, "LogitsProcessor", lambda *args: nn.Identity())
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(hf_config=BeamConfig()),
+        quant_config=None,
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_eplb=False, use_sequence_parallel_moe=False
+        ),
+    )
+
+    model = beam.BeamForCausalLM(vllm_config=config)
+
+    assert model.moe_layers == []
+    assert model.num_moe_layers == 0
+    assert model.num_logical_experts == 0
+    assert model.num_local_physical_experts == 0
+
+
+class _AddOneLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Adds one to the residual stream and hands the next layer double that."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.input_layernorm = nn.Identity()
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, normalized_states, next_norm_weight):
+        hidden_states = hidden_states + 1
+        return hidden_states, hidden_states * 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_dflash_target_layers_capture_layer_outputs(monkeypatch):
+    """DFlash `target_layer_ids` name the layer whose output is captured."""
+    model = beam.BeamModel.__new__(beam.BeamModel)
+    nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.start_layer, model.end_layer = 0, 3
+    model.layers = nn.ModuleList([_AddOneLayer() for _ in range(3)])
+    model.norm = nn.Identity()
+    target = beam.BeamForCausalLM.__new__(beam.BeamForCausalLM)
+    nn.Module.__init__(target)
+    target.model = model
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        beam,
+        "get_pp_group",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(is_first_rank=True, is_last_rank=True),
+    )
+    spec_config = SimpleNamespace(

+def _torch_rms_norm(x, weight, eps):
+    y = x.float()
+    y = y * torch.rsqrt(y.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps) * weight.float()
+    return y.to(x.dtype)
+
+
+def _torch_boundary(x, residual, post_weight, post_eps, next_weight, next_eps, scales):
+    x = _torch_rms_norm(x, post_weight, post_eps) * scales[0]
+    hidden = x + residual.to(x.dtype) * scales[1]
+    normalized = (
+        _torch_rms_norm(hidden, next_weight, next_eps) if next_eps is not None else None
+    )
+    return hidden, normalized
+
+
+def _assert_boundary_close(actual, expected, *, relative_tolerance=1e-4):
+    for value, reference in zip(actual, expected):
+        if reference is None:
+            assert value is None
+            continue
+        bf16 = reference.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            value,
+            reference,
+            rtol=0.016 if bf16 else 2e-5,
+            atol=0.016 if bf16 else 2e-6,
+        )
+        # Allow isolated BF16 rounding differences, but catch omitted casts.
+        if reference.numel():
+            error = (value.float() - reference.float()).norm()
+            assert error <= reference.float().norm() * (
+                relative_tolerance if bf16 else 2e-6
+            )
+

+def _separate_qk_norm_rope(
+    q,
+    k,
+    qw,
+    kw,
+    eps,
+    positions,
+    cache,
+    head_dim,
+    rotary_dim=0,
+    neox=True,
+    ssmax=False,
+):
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+
+    q = _torch_rms_norm(
+        q.reshape(-1, q.shape[-1] // head_dim, head_dim), qw, eps
+    ).reshape_as(q)
+    k = _torch_rms_norm(
+        k.reshape(-1, k.shape[-1] // head_dim, head_dim), kw, eps
+    ).reshape_as(k)
+    if rotary_dim and q.shape[0]:
+        qf, kf = q.float(), k.float()
+        ops.rotary_embedding(positions, qf, kf, head_dim, cache, neox)
+        q, k = qf.to(q.dtype), kf.to(k.dtype)
+    elif ssmax:
+        scale = (0.1 * torch.log1p((positions.float() + 1) / 2048)).exp()
+        q = (q * scale[:, None]).to(q.dtype)
+    return q, k

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["size"])
+def _silu_mul_kernel(X, Y, size, width: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    src = i // width * (2 * width) + i % width
+    gate = tl.load(X + src, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    up = tl.load(X + src + width, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    act = tl.div_rn(gate, 1.0 + libdevice.exp(-gate))
+    tl.store(Y + i, act * up, i < size)
+
+
+def beam_silu_mul(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute SiLU and multiplication in FP32, rounding only the product."""
+    width = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    output = torch.empty((*x.shape[:-1], width), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if output.numel():
+        _silu_mul_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 1024),)](
+            x, output, output.numel(), width, 1024, enable_fp_fusion=False
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _softcap_logits_kernel(
+    X,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CAP: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    x = tl.load(X + row * STRIDE + col, col < WIDTH, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = libdevice.tanh(x * (1.0 / CAP)) * CAP
+    tl.store(X + row * STRIDE + col, y, col < WIDTH)
+
+
+def beam_softcap_logits(logits: torch.Tensor, cap: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Softcap in FP32 and round back into the original logits buffer."""
+    assert logits.ndim == 2 and logits.stride(1) == 1
+    if logits.numel():
+        _softcap_logits_kernel[(logits.shape[0], triton.cdiv(logits.shape[1], 1024))](
+            logits,
+            logits.shape[1],
+            logits.stride(0),
+            cap,
+            1024,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+            enable_reflect_ftz=False,
+        )
+    return logits

+import torch
+from torch import nn

+from vllm.config import CacheConfig

+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+    QKVParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+    UnquantizedLinearMethod,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import sharded_weight_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import set_weight_attrs
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.beam import BeamConfig
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionType
+
+from .attention_ops import beam_output_gate, beam_qk_norm_rope
+from .layernorm import RMSNorm
+from .projection import (
+    packed_projection,
+    use_low_latency_gemm,
+    warmup_packed_projection,
+)
+
+
+def use_merged_qkv_gate(config: BeamConfig, tp_size: int) -> bool:
+    return config.num_key_value_heads >= tp_size
+
+
+class BeamAttention(nn.Module):
+    """GQA with per-head Q/K RMSNorm, then RoPE (sliding-window layers) or
+    SSMax (NoPE full-attention layers). The attention output is scaled by
+    ``sigmoid(gate + bias)`` before ``o_proj``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: BeamConfig,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_id = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.total_num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        assert self.total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        if self.total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            assert self.total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            assert tp_size % self.total_num_kv_heads == 0
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim or (hidden_size // self.total_num_heads)
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+
+        self.merged_qkv_gate = use_merged_qkv_gate(config, tp_size)
+        if self.merged_qkv_gate:
+            self.qkv_gate_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                [
+                    self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+                    self.total_num_kv_heads * self.head_dim,
+                    self.total_num_kv_heads * self.head_dim,
+                    self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+                ],
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_gate_proj",
+            )
+        else:
+            self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                self.head_dim,
+                self.total_num_heads,
+                self.total_num_kv_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+            )
+            self.output_gate_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.output_gate_proj",
+            )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+
+        self.rms_norm_eps = config.rms_norm_eps
+        self.q_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim)
+        self.k_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim)
+        # The output gate has a separate bias per head.
+        self.gate_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.num_heads))
+        set_weight_attrs(self.gate_bias, {"weight_loader": sharded_weight_loader(0)})
+
+        is_sliding = config.layer_types[self.layer_id] == "sliding_attention"
+        self.disable_rope = not is_sliding
+        if self.disable_rope:
+            self.rotary_emb = None
+        else:
+            self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+                self.head_dim,
+                max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+                is_neox_style=True,
+                rope_parameters=config.rope_parameters,
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+            )
+
+        # Backends interpret `sliding_window` as `(q - k) <= sliding_window - 1`.
+        per_layer_sw = config.sliding_window if is_sliding else None
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            per_layer_sliding_window=per_layer_sw,
+            attn_type=AttentionType.DECODER,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+        )
+
+        self.fuse_kv_insert = (
+            self.attn.attn_backend.get_name() in ("FLASH_ATTN", "FLASHINFER")
+            and self.attn.impl.dcp_world_size == 1
+            and self.attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+        )
+        self.low_latency_projection = False
+
+    def warmup_projection(self) -> None:
+        if not self.merged_qkv_gate:
+            return
+        projection = self.qkv_gate_proj
+        self.low_latency_projection = isinstance(
+            projection.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod
+        ) and use_low_latency_gemm(projection.weight)
+        if self.low_latency_projection:
+            warmup_packed_projection(projection.weight)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.merged_qkv_gate:
+            if self.low_latency_projection:
+                packed = packed_projection(
+                    hidden_states, self.qkv_gate_proj.weight, True
+                )
+            else:
+                packed, _ = self.qkv_gate_proj(hidden_states)
+            qkv, gate = packed.split(
+                [self.q_size + 2 * self.kv_size, self.q_size], dim=-1
+            )
+        else:
+            qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+            gate, _ = self.output_gate_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+
+        kv_cache, slot_mapping = None, None
+        if (
+            self.fuse_kv_insert
+            and self.attn.kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            slots = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+            if isinstance(slots, dict):
+                slot_mapping = slots.get(self.attn.layer_name)
+                if slot_mapping is not None:
+                    kv_cache = self.attn.kv_cache

+"""Fused Q/K normalization, position transforms, and attention output gating."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice

+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["SIZE"])
+def _output_gate_kernel(
+    X,
+    G,
+    B,
+    Y,
+    SIZE,
+    G_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = G.dtype.element_ty
+    g_idx = i // (HEADS * DIM) * G_STRIDE + i % (HEADS * DIM)
+    g = tl.load(G + g_idx, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    b = tl.load(B + i // DIM % HEADS).to(tl.float32)
+    g = (g + b).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    sigmoid = (1.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-g))).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    x = tl.load(X + i, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(Y + i, x * sigmoid, i < SIZE)
+
+
+def beam_output_gate(
+    attn_output: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    num_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``attn_output * sigmoid(gate + gate_bias)`` with activation-dtype rounding
+    after the bias add and the sigmoid."""
+    output = torch.empty_like(attn_output)
+    if output.numel():
+        if (
+            attn_output.dtype == gate.dtype == gate_bias.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        ):
+            from .attention_ops_cutedsl import run
+
+            run(attn_output, gate, gate_bias, num_heads, head_dim, output)
+            return output
+        _output_gate_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 256),)](
+            attn_output,
+            gate,
+            gate_bias,
+            output,
+            output.numel(),
+            gate.stride(0),
+            num_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            256,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output
+

+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=["M", "NUM_SLOTS"], do_not_specialize_on_alignment=["POS"]
+)
+def _qk_norm_rope_kernel(
+    Q,
+    K,
+    QW,
+    KW,
+    POS,
+    CACHE,
+    OQ,
+    OK,
+    M,
+    V,
+    KV_CACHE,
+    SLOTS,
+    NUM_SLOTS,
+    WRITE_CACHE: tl.constexpr,
+    V_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_BLOCK_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_HEAD_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    TOKENS: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    K_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    K_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    ROTARY: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    SSMAX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * TOKENS + tl.arange(0, TOKENS)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < DIM)
+    if head < Q_HEADS:
+        x = tl.load(
+            Q + token[:, None] * Q_STRIDE + head * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        y = y * tl.load(QW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]
+        out = OQ + (token[:, None] * Q_HEADS + head) * DIM
+    else:
+        h = head - Q_HEADS
+        x = tl.load(K + token[:, None] * K_STRIDE + h * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        y = y * tl.load(KW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]

+        half: tl.constexpr = ROTARY // 2

+            partner = tl.where(c < half, c + half, c - half)
+            second = c >= half
+            offset = c % half
+        else:
+            partner = c ^ 1
+            second = c % 2 != 0
+            offset = c // 2
+        partner = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(partner, 0), BLOCK - 1)
+        other = tl.gather(y, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (TOKENS, BLOCK)), axis=1)
+        pos = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.int64)
+        rope_mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < ROTARY)
+        cos = tl.load(CACHE + pos[:, None] * ROTARY + offset[None, :], rope_mask, 0)
+        sin = tl.load(
+            CACHE + pos[:, None] * ROTARY + half + offset[None, :], rope_mask, 0
+        )
+        # Match the FP32 multiply/FMA ordering of the CUDA RoPE kernel.
+        rotated = tl.where(
+            second[None, :],
+            tl.fma(other, sin, y * cos),
+            tl.fma(y, cos, -other * sin),
+        )
+        y = tl.where(c[None, :] < ROTARY, rotated, y)
+    elif SSMAX:
+        if head < Q_HEADS:
+            # (1 + (position + 1) / 2048) ** 0.1
+            p = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.float32) + 1
+            scale = libdevice.exp(0.1 * libdevice.log1p(p / 2048.0))
+            y = y * scale[:, None]
+    tl.store(out + c[None, :], y, mask)
+    if WRITE_CACHE and head >= Q_HEADS:
+        slot = tl.load(SLOTS + token, token < NUM_SLOTS, -1).to(tl.int64)
+        cache_mask = mask & (token[:, None] < NUM_SLOTS) & (slot[:, None] >= 0)
+        address = (
+            slot[:, None] // PAGE_SIZE * CACHE_BLOCK_STRIDE
+            + slot[:, None] % PAGE_SIZE * CACHE_TOKEN_STRIDE
+            + (head - Q_HEADS) * CACHE_HEAD_STRIDE
+            + c[None, :]
+        )
+        tl.store(KV_CACHE + address, y, cache_mask)
+        value = tl.load(
+            V + token[:, None] * V_STRIDE + (head - Q_HEADS) * DIM + c[None, :],
+            cache_mask,
+            0,
+        )
+        tl.store(KV_CACHE + address + DIM, value, cache_mask)
+
+
+def beam_qk_norm_rope(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    q_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int = 0,
+    is_neox_style: bool = True,
+    *,
+    ssmax: bool = False,
+    value: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | None = None,

+    """Round norm before position transforms and optionally insert BF16 K/V."""
+    if kv_cache is not None:

+            cos_sin_cache,
+            q_out,
+            k_out,
+            q.shape[0],
+            value,
+            kv_cache,
+            slot_mapping,
+            slot_mapping.numel() if slot_mapping is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache is not None,
+            value.stride(0) if value is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(0) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(1) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(2) if kv_cache is not None else 0,

+            k_heads,

+            is_neox_style,
+            ssmax,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(head_dim),
+            num_warps=warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return q_out, k_out

+            "mov.b64 p, {lo, hi};",
+            "mul.rn.f32x2 p, p, kl;",
+            "mov.b64 {a0, a1}, p;",
+            "ex2.approx.ftz.f32 a0, a0;",
+            "ex2.approx.ftz.f32 a1, a1;",
+            "mov.b64 p, {a0, a1};",
+            "add.rn.f32x2 p, p, k1;",
+            "mov.b64 {a0, a1}, p;",
+            "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a0, a0;",
+            "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a1, a1;",
+            "cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 w, a1, a0;",
+            f"mul.rn.bf16x2 ${j}, w, {x};",
+        ]
+    s.append("}")
+    return "\n".join(s)

+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_vec(gs, xs, b, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """Gate 2 or 4 packed BF16x2 pairs sharing one bias word."""
+    n = len(gs)
+    ops = [Uint32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for v in gs + xs + [b]]
+    res = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * n),
+        ops,
+        _gate_vec_ptx(n),
+        ",".join(["=r"] * n + ["r"] * len(ops)),
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return [
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), res, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)) for i in range(n)
+    ]
+
+
+def _gate_one_ptx():
+    return "\n".join(
+        [
+            "{",
+            ".reg .b16 g, b, x, w;",
+            ".reg .f32 a, r;",
+            "cvt.u16.u32 g, $1;",
+            "cvt.u16.u32 x, $2;",
+            "cvt.u16.u32 b, $3;",
+            "add.rn.bf16 w, g, b;",
+            "cvt.f32.bf16 a, w;",
+            "mul.rn.f32 a, a, 0fBFB8AA3B;",
+            "ex2.approx.ftz.f32 a, a;",
+            "add.rn.f32 a, a, 0f3F800000;",
+            "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 r, a;",
+            "cvt.rn.bf16.f32 w, r;",
+            "mul.rn.bf16 w, w, x;",
+            "mov.b32 $0, {w, w};",
+            "}",
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_one(g, x, b, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    ops = [
+        Uint32(g).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Uint32(x).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Uint32(b).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+    ]
+    return Uint32(_asm(T.i32(), ops, _gate_one_ptx(), "=r,r,r,r", loc, ip))
+
+
+def _ld_words(addr, VEC, PF256):
+    if const_expr(VEC == 8):
+        return ld_v4(addr, ".L2::256B" if PF256 else "")
+    elif const_expr(VEC == 4):
+        return ld_v2(addr, ".L2::256B" if PF256 else ".L2::128B")
+    elif const_expr(VEC == 2):
+        return ld_b32(addr)

+
+@cute.kernel
+def _gate2d_kernel(
+    x_addr: Int64,
+    g_addr: Int64,
+    b_addr: Int64,
+    o_addr: Int64,
+    n_rows: Int32,
+    W: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    G_STRIDE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    VEC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    E: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    R: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BLOCK: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BIAS_MODE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROW_EXACT: cutlass.Constexpr,

+    ROWS_ON_X: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PF256: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    INTERLEAVED8: cutlass.Constexpr,

+    cols = []
+    colcs = []
+    bws = []
+    for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):

+        colcs.append(colc)
+        if const_expr(BIAS_MODE == 1):
+            bw = [ld_bias_b16x2(b_addr + Int64(colc // Uint32(D)) * 2)] * nwords
+        else:
+            bw = []
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(nwords):
+                lo = ld_b16(b_addr + Int64((colc + Uint32(2 * j)) // Uint32(D)) * 2)
+                if const_expr(VEC > 1):
+                    hi = ld_b16(
+                        b_addr + Int64((colc + Uint32(2 * j + 1)) // Uint32(D)) * 2
+                    )
+                    bw.append(lo | (hi << 16))
+                else:
+                    bw.append(lo)

+
+    rows = []
+    xs = []
+    gs = []
+    for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+        row = Uint32(0) if const_expr(ONE_ROW) else row0 + Uint32(r)
+        rowc = (
+            row
+            if const_expr(ONE_ROW or ROW_EXACT)
+            else cutlass.min(row, Uint32(n_rows) - Uint32(1))
+        )
+        rows.append(row)
+        if const_expr(ONE_ROW):
+            x_row = x_addr
+            g_row = g_addr
+        else:
+            x_row = x_addr + Int64(rowc) * (W * 2)
+            g_row = g_addr + Int64(rowc) * (G_STRIDE * 2)
+        xr = []
+        gr = []
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+            xr.append(_ld_words(x_row + Int64(colcs[e]) * 2, VEC, PF256))
+            gr.append(_ld_words(g_row + Int64(colcs[e]) * 2, VEC, PF256))
+        xs.append(xr)
+        gs.append(gr)
+
+    outs = []
+    if const_expr(VEC == 1):
+        flat_g = []
+        flat_x = []
+        flat_b = []
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+                flat_g.append(gs[r][e][0])
+                flat_x.append(xs[r][e][0])
+                flat_b.append(bws[e][0])
+        n = R * E
+        flat_o = []
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, n, 2):
+            if const_expr(i + 1 < n):
+                rr = gate_pair(
+                    flat_g[i] | (flat_g[i + 1] << 16),
+                    flat_x[i] | (flat_x[i + 1] << 16),
+                    (flat_b[i] & Uint32(0xFFFF)) | (flat_b[i + 1] << 16),
+                )
+                flat_o.append(rr)
+                flat_o.append(rr >> 16)
+            else:
+                flat_o.append(gate_one(flat_g[i], flat_x[i], flat_b[i]))
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            outs.append([[flat_o[r * E + e]] for e in range(E)])
+    else:
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            orow = []
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+                if const_expr(VEC >= 4 and BIAS_MODE == 1):
+                    if const_expr(VEC == 4):
+                        ow = gate_vec_exp_interleaved(gs[r][e], xs[r][e], bws[e][0])
+                    elif const_expr(INTERLEAVED8):
+                        ow = gate_vec_exp_interleaved(
+                            gs[r][e][0:2], xs[r][e][0:2], bws[e][0]
+                        ) + gate_vec_exp_interleaved(
+                            gs[r][e][2:4], xs[r][e][2:4], bws[e][0]
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        ow = gate_vec(gs[r][e], xs[r][e], bws[e][0])
+                else:
+                    ow = [
+                        gate_pair(gs[r][e][j], xs[r][e][j], bws[e][j])
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(nwords)
+                    ]
+                orow.append(ow)
+            outs.append(orow)
+
+    st_pol = make_policy("evict_last") if const_expr(VEC == 8) else None
+    for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+        o_row = o_addr if const_expr(ONE_ROW) else o_addr + Int64(rows[r]) * (W * 2)
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+            addr = o_row + Int64(cols[e]) * 2
+            if const_expr(ROW_EXACT and col_exact):
+                if const_expr(VEC == 1):
+                    st_b16(addr, outs[r][e][0])
+                elif const_expr(st_pol is not None):
+                    st_v4_hint(addr, outs[r][e], st_pol)
+                else:
+                    st_vec(addr, outs[r][e])
+            else:
+                if const_expr(ROW_EXACT):
+                    ok = cols[e] < Uint32(W)
+                elif const_expr(col_exact):
+                    ok = rows[r] < Uint32(n_rows)
+                else:
+                    ok = (rows[r] < Uint32(n_rows)) & (cols[e] < Uint32(W))
+                if ok:
+                    if const_expr(VEC == 1):
+                        st_b16(addr, outs[r][e][0])
+                    elif const_expr(st_pol is not None):
+                        st_v4_hint(addr, outs[r][e], st_pol)
+                    else:
+                        st_vec(addr, outs[r][e])
+

+@cute.jit
+def _gate2d_launch(
+    x_addr: Int64,
+    g_addr: Int64,
+    b_addr: Int64,
+    o_addr: Int64,
+    n_rows: Int32,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    W: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    G_STRIDE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    VEC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    E: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    R: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BLOCK: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BIAS_MODE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROW_EXACT: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ONE_ROW: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROWS_ON_X: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CLUSTER_LAUNCH: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PF256: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    INTERLEAVED8: cutlass.Constexpr,

+    ncb = (W + BLOCK * VEC * E - 1) // (BLOCK * VEC * E)
+    nrb = (n_rows + (R - 1)) // R
+    grid = [nrb, ncb, 1] if const_expr(ROWS_ON_X) else [ncb, nrb, 1]
+    kernel = _gate2d_kernel(
+        x_addr,
+        g_addr,
+        b_addr,
+        o_addr,
+        n_rows,
+        W,
+        D,
+        G_STRIDE,
+        VEC,
+        E,
+        R,
+        BLOCK,
+        BIAS_MODE,
+        ROW_EXACT,
+        ONE_ROW,
+        ROWS_ON_X,
+        PF256,
+        INTERLEAVED8,
+    )

+    # end
+    # latency on B300, and adding the cooperative (co-resident) attribute on top of that
+    # a
+    # further 1-3 timer ticks; large grids lose CTA launch throughput this way.
+    if const_expr(CLUSTER_LAUNCH == 2):
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid,
+            block=[BLOCK, 1, 1],
+            cluster=[1, 1, 1],
+            cooperative=True,
+            stream=stream,
+            preferred_smem_carveout=0,
+            min_blocks_per_mp=1,
+        )
+    elif const_expr(CLUSTER_LAUNCH == 1):
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid,
+            block=[BLOCK, 1, 1],
+            cluster=[1, 1, 1],
+            stream=stream,
+            preferred_smem_carveout=0,
+        )
+    else:
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid, block=[BLOCK, 1, 1], stream=stream, preferred_smem_carveout=0
+        )
+

+_cache: dict[tuple, Callable] = {}
+_no_coop = set()
+_CLUSTER_MAX_CTAS = 768

+# B300

+# refused).

+def _num_sms():
+    if not _sm_count:

+                torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+            ).multi_processor_count
+        )
+    return _sm_count[0]
+

+def _max_vec(W, gs, ptrs):
+    for vec in (8, 4, 2):
+        if W % vec == 0 and gs % vec == 0 and all(p % (2 * vec) == 0 for p in ptrs):
+            return vec
+    return 1
+
+
+def _coop_fits(ncta, block, regs):
+    """Conservative co-residency bound (no shared memory; regs rounded up per warp)."""
+    per_warp = -(-regs * 32 // 256) * 256
+    by_regs = 65536 // (per_warp * -(-block // 32))
+    per_sm = min(32, 2048 // block, by_regs)
+    return ncta <= min(_COOP_MAX_CTAS, _num_sms() * per_sm)

+    """Return launch parameters and an optional cooperative register bound."""
+    n = T_ * W
+    if n <= 512 * 1024:

+        # CTAs
+        # up to 64K elements, then 8-byte packets with ~1.5-3K warps in flight.
+        pf256 = False
+        if n <= 16 * 1024:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 1, 1, 128
+        elif n <= 32 * 1024:
+            # A 256-thread scalar CTA spans 512 B: request 256 B per L2 miss.
+            vec, e, block_cap, pf256 = 1, 1, 256, True
+        elif n <= 64 * 1024:
+            # 512-thread scalar CTAs each cover 1 KB of a row: fetch 256 B per L2 miss.
+            vec, e, block_cap, pf256 = 1, 1, 512, True
+        elif n <= 128 * 1024:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 4, 1, 256
+        elif n <= 256 * 1024:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 4, 1, 512
+        else:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 4, 1, 384
+        vec = min(vec, maxvec)
+        if vec != 1:
+            pf256 = False
+        need = -(-W // (vec * e))
+        return vec, e, 1, min(block_cap, max(32, -(-need // 32) * 32)), pf256, None

+        vec, e, r = 8, 1, 1
+    else:
+        vec, e, r = 8, 1, 1 if contiguous_gate else 2
+    vec = min(vec, maxvec)
+    if vec == 8 and n > 1024 * 1024:
+        # Two rows per 192-thread CTA keep the T=512 primary grid co-resident.
+        ncb = -(-W // (192 * 8))
+        if ncb * 192 * 8 - W < 192 * 8 // 2 and _coop_fits(ncb * -(-T_ // 2), 192, 32):
+            return 8, 1, 2, 192, False, 32
+    need = -(-W // (vec * e))
+    block_cap = 256 if vec == 8 and 512 * 1024 <= n <= 1024 * 1024 else 128
+    if (
+        vec == 8
+        and n > 1024 * 1024
+        and -(-T_ // r) * -(-W // (256 * vec * e)) <= _CLUSTER_MAX_CTAS
+    ):
+        block_cap = 256  # keeps ~1-1.5M-element grids within the cluster-launch tier
+    block = min(block_cap, max(32, -(-need // 32) * 32))
+    return vec, e, r, block, False, None
+
+
+def run(attn_output, gate, gate_bias, num_heads, head_dim, output):

+    D = int(head_dim)

+"""DFlash2 draft model for Beam targets.
+
+A DFlash2 drafter predicts a block of tokens at once from hidden states the
+Beam target captures at `dflash_config.target_layer_ids`, then a low-rank
+candidate selector rescores the top-k tokens at each block position against
+the token before it. The drafter shares the target's embeddings and LM head.
+
+Nothing here is torch-compiled. The DFlash speculator captures the whole draft
+step (decoder layers, candidate head and selector) in its own CUDA graphs, and
+the context K/V precompute runs eagerly as a few fused kernels.
+"""

+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from .attention_ops import beam_qk_norm_rope
+
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        cache, slots = None, None
+        mapping = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+        assert isinstance(mapping, dict)
+        if mapping and self.attn.kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+            slots = mapping[self.attn.layer_name]
+            cache = self.attn.kv_cache
+            assert self.attn.attn_backend.get_name() in ("FLASH_ATTN", "FLASHINFER")
+            assert self.attn.impl.dcp_world_size == 1
+            assert self.attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+            assert cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            assert cache.ndim == 4
+        rope = self.rotary_emb
+        q, k = beam_qk_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            self.q_norm.weight,
+            self.k_norm.weight,
+            self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            positions,
+            rope.cos_sin_cache,
+            self.head_dim,
+            rope.rotary_dim,
+            rope.is_neox_style,
+            value=v,
+            kv_cache=cache,
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+        )
+        output = self.attn(q, k, v) if cache is None else self.attn(q, None, None)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(output)

+class DFlash2BeamMLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, intermediate_size: int, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            [intermediate_size] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            intermediate_size,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+        )
+        self.act_fn = SiluAndMul()
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        x, _ = self.down_proj(self.act_fn(x))
+        return x

+class DFlash2BeamDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Takes the normalized input and returns the next layer's normalized input,
+    fusing each grouped convolution's second half into the residual norm."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        config,
+        layer_idx: int,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.self_attn = DFlash2BeamAttention(
+            config, layer_idx, vllm_config.cache_config, f"{prefix}.self_attn"
+        )
+        self.mlp = DFlash2BeamMLP(
+            config.hidden_size, config.intermediate_size, f"{prefix}.mlp"
+        )
+        self.input_layernorm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+        draft_config = config.dflash_config
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        conv_args = dict(
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            taps=int(draft_config["conv_kernel_size"]),
+            group_size=int(draft_config["conv_group_size"]),
+            # Query tokens per request: the bonus token plus the mask tokens.
+            block_size=1 + vllm_config.speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens,
+            params_dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+        )
+        self.attention_conv = DFlashGroupedConv(
+            **conv_args, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "attention_conv")
+        )
+        self.mlp_conv = DFlashGroupedConv(
+            **conv_args, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "mlp_conv")
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        next_norm: RMSNorm,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        from .dflash2_conv_ops import conv_residual_norm
+
+        conv = self.attention_conv
+        hidden_states, coefficients = conv.prepare(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn(positions, hidden_states)
+        hidden_states, residual = conv_residual_norm(
+            hidden_states,
+            coefficients,
+            conv.base_kernel[1],
+            residual,
+            self.post_attention_layernorm.weight,
+            self.post_attention_layernorm.variance_epsilon,
+            conv.block_size,
+            conv.group_size,
+        )
+        conv = self.mlp_conv
+        hidden_states, coefficients = conv.prepare(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
+        return conv_residual_norm(
+            hidden_states,
+            coefficients,
+            conv.base_kernel[1],
+            residual,
+            next_norm.weight,
+            next_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            conv.block_size,
+            conv.group_size,
+        )

+class DFlash2BeamCandidateSelector(nn.Module):
+    """Scores each candidate token against every candidate one position back.
+
+    For block position `p`, candidate `c` and predecessor `q`, the score is the
+    candidate's own logit plus `<predecessor[q] * h_p, successor[c]>`, where
+    `h_p` is the drafter's hidden state projected to the codebook rank. The
+    predecessor of the first position is the anchor token.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        rank: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.predecessor_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(vocab_size, rank, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.successor_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(vocab_size, rank, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.hidden_projection = ReplicatedLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            rank,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "hidden_projection"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        candidate_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        unary_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        anchor_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Edge scores `[requests, steps, top_k (predecessor), top_k]`."""
+        assert hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        return candidate_edges(
+            self.predecessor_codebook,
+            self.successor_codebook,
+            candidate_ids,
+            unary_logits,
+            self.hidden_projection(hidden_states),
+            anchor_token_ids,
+            self.top_k,
+        )

+class DFlash2BeamModel(nn.Module):

+            ".k_proj": (".qkv_proj", "k"),
+            ".v_proj": (".qkv_proj", "v"),

+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["ROWS", "NUM_SLOTS"])
+def _context_kv_kernel(
+    KV,
+    WEIGHT,
+    POSITIONS,
+    ROPE,
+    CACHE_PTRS,
+    CACHE,
+    SCALE_PTRS,
+    SLOTS,
+    ROWS,
+    NUM_SLOTS,
+    LAYERS: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    FP8: tl.constexpr,
+    FP8_MAX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * 4 + tl.arange(0, 4)
+    layer_head = tl.program_id(1)
+    layer = layer_head // HEADS
+    head = layer_head % HEADS
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    slot = tl.load(SLOTS + row, (row < ROWS) & (row < NUM_SLOTS), -1).to(tl.int64)
+    mask = (row[:, None] < ROWS) & (slot[:, None] >= 0) & (col[None, :] < DIM)
+    offsets = (
+        row[:, None] * (LAYERS * 2 * HEADS * DIM)
+        + (layer * 2 * HEADS + head) * DIM
+        + col[None, :]
+    )
+    key = tl.load(KV + offsets, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BLOCK == 128:
+        squares = (key * key).reshape((4, 4, 32))
+        total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+    else:
+        total = tl.sum(key * key, 1)
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + layer * DIM + col, col < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    key = key * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None] * weight[None, :]
+    key = key.to(KV.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)

+    partner = (col + half) % DIM
+    second = col >= half
+    rope_col = col % half
+    other = tl.gather(key, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (4, BLOCK)), 1)
+    position = tl.load(POSITIONS + row, (row < ROWS) & (slot >= 0), 0).to(tl.int64)
+    cosine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    sine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + half + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    key = tl.where(
+        second[None, :],
+        tl.fma(other, sine, key * cosine),
+        tl.fma(key, cosine, -other * sine),
+    )

+    address = (
+        slot[:, None] // PAGE * BLOCK_STRIDE
+        + slot[:, None] % PAGE * TOKEN_STRIDE

+    value = tl.load(KV + offsets + HEADS * DIM, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _conv_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    DELTA,
+    BASE,
+    RESIDUAL,
+    WEIGHT,
+    OUTPUT,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_ROW_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_TAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    RESIDUAL_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    TAPS: tl.constexpr,
+    QUERY: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = col < WIDTH
+    group = col // GROUP
+    coefficient = tl.load(BASE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32) + tl.load(
+        DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + group, mask, 0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    value = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = coefficient * value
+    for tap in tl.static_range(1, TAPS):
+        valid = mask & (row % QUERY >= tap)
+        coefficient = tl.load(BASE + tap * WIDTH + col, valid, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        ) + tl.load(
+            DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + tap * DELTA_TAP_STRIDE + group, valid, 0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        value = tl.load(X + (row - tap) * X_STRIDE + col, valid, 0).to(tl.float32)
+        result = tl.fma(coefficient, value, result)
+    result = result.to(X.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    residual = tl.load(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = (result + residual).to(RESIDUAL.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, result, mask)
+    variance = tl.sum(result * result, 0) / WIDTH
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    normalized = result * tl.rsqrt(variance + EPS) * weight
+    tl.store(OUTPUT + row * WIDTH + col, normalized, mask)
+
+
+def conv_residual_norm(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    coefficients: torch.Tensor,
+    base: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    query_len: int,
+    group_size: int,
+    *,
+    num_warps: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Finish grouped convolution and update the residual before RMSNorm."""
+    rows, width = hidden.shape
+    if num_warps is None:
+        num_warps = 16 if rows <= 256 else (8 if rows < 4096 else 4)
+    output = torch.empty_like(hidden)
+    if rows:
+        _conv_residual_norm_kernel[(rows,)](
+            hidden,
+            coefficients,
+            base,
+            residual,
+            weight,
+            output,
+            hidden.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(1),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            width,
+            group_size,
+            base.shape[0],
+            query_len,
+            eps,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(width),
+            num_warps=num_warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output, residual

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _candidate_edges_kernel(
+    PREDECESSORS,
+    SUCCESSORS,
+    IDS,
+    UNARY,
+    HIDDEN,
+    ANCHORS,
+    OUTPUT,
+    ANCHOR_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    position = tl.program_id(0)
+    predecessor = tl.program_id(1)
+    step = position % STEPS
+    if step == 0:
+        pred_id = tl.load(ANCHORS + position // STEPS * ANCHOR_STRIDE).to(tl.int64)
+    else:
+        pred_id = tl.load(IDS + (position - 1) * TOP_K + predecessor).to(tl.int64)
+    r = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    pred = tl.load(PREDECESSORS + pred_id.to(tl.int64) * RANK + r, r < RANK, 0)
+    hidden = tl.load(HIDDEN + position * RANK + r, r < RANK, 0)
+    # Preserve the materialized product and GEMM's output rounding.
+    weighted = (pred.to(tl.float32) * hidden.to(tl.float32)).to(hidden.dtype)
+    ids = tl.load(IDS + position * TOP_K + c, c < TOP_K, 0).to(tl.int64)
+    successors = tl.load(
+        SUCCESSORS + ids[:, None] * RANK + r[None, :],
+        (c[:, None] < TOP_K) & (r[None, :] < RANK),
+        0,
+    )
+    scores = tl.sum(successors.to(tl.float32) * weighted[None, :].to(tl.float32), 1)
+    scores = scores.to(hidden.dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    unary = tl.load(UNARY + position * TOP_K + c, c < TOP_K, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        OUTPUT + (position * TOP_K + predecessor) * TOP_K + c, scores + unary, c < TOP_K
+    )
+
+
+def candidate_edges(
+    predecessor_table: torch.Tensor,
+    successor_table: torch.Tensor,
+    candidate_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    unary_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    anchor_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    top_k: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Gather codebooks and score candidate edges without intermediate tensors."""
+    batch, steps, _ = candidate_ids.shape
+    rank = hidden.shape[-1]
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (batch, steps, top_k, top_k), dtype=unary_logits.dtype, device=hidden.device
+    )
+    if batch * steps:
+        _candidate_edges_kernel[(batch * steps, top_k)](
+            predecessor_table,
+            successor_table,
+            candidate_ids,
+            unary_logits,
+            hidden,
+            anchor_token_ids,
+            output,
+            anchor_token_ids.stride(0),
+            steps,
+            top_k,
+            rank,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(top_k),
+            triton.next_power_of_2(rank),
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Beam kernels preserving FP32 normalization and affine arithmetic."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Parameters for normalization performed directly by the model kernels."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size))
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("Call the model's fused normalization kernels directly")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rms_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    W,
+    Y,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_TOKEN: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_HEAD: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    token = row // HEADS
+    head = row % HEADS
+    x = tl.load(
+        X + token * STRIDE_TOKEN + head * STRIDE_HEAD + idx, idx < N, other=0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    mean = tl.sum(x * x, 0) / N
+    y = x * tl.rsqrt(mean + EPS)
+    w = tl.load(W + idx, idx < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = y * w
+    tl.store(Y + row * N + idx, y, idx < N)
+
+
+def beam_rms_norm(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, eps: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Normalize strided token/head rows, rounding only after the affine multiply."""
+    assert x.ndim in (2, 3) and x.stride(-1) == 1
+    n = x.shape[-1]
+    heads = x.shape[1] if x.ndim == 3 else 1
+    out = torch.empty(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    if out.numel() == 0:
+        return out
+    _rms_norm_kernel[(x.numel() // n,)](
+        x,
+        weight,
+        out,
+        n,
+        heads,
+        x.stride(0),
+        x.stride(-2) if x.ndim == 3 else n,
+        eps,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(n),
+        num_warps=4 if n <= 1024 else 8,
+        enable_fp_fusion=False,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _boundary_math(
+    x,
+    r,
+    POST_W,
+    NEXT_W,
+    col,
+    dtype: tl.constexpr,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    X_SCALE,
+    R_SCALE,
+    NEXT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    x = x * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, 0) / N + POST_EPS)
+    w = tl.load(POST_W + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    x = (x * w).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    x = (x * X_SCALE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    r = (r * R_SCALE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    h = (x + r).to(dtype)
+    if NEXT_NORM:
+        h_fp32 = tl.where(col < N, h.to(tl.float32), 0)
+        y = h_fp32 * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(h_fp32 * h_fp32, 0) / N + NEXT_EPS)
+        w = tl.load(NEXT_W + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+        y = y * w
+    else:
+        y = h
+    return h, y
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    R,
+    POST_W,
+    NEXT_W,
+    H,
+    Y,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    R_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    X_SCALE,
+    R_SCALE,
+    NEXT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = X.dtype.element_ty
+    x = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    r = tl.load(R + row * R_STRIDE + col, col < N, other=0).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    h, y = _boundary_math(
+        x,
+        r,
+        POST_W,
+        NEXT_W,
+        col,
+        dtype,
+        N,
+        POST_EPS,
+        NEXT_EPS,
+        X_SCALE,
+        R_SCALE,
+        NEXT_NORM,
+    )
+    tl.store(H + row * N + col, h, col < N)
+    if NEXT_NORM:
+        tl.store(Y + row * N + col, y, col < N)
+
+
+def beam_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    post_eps: float,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float],
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """Fuse post-norm, scaled residual add and next pre-norm, keeping each cast.
+
+    Returns the new residual and, when ``next_weight`` is given, its
+    normalization for the next sublayer.
+    """
+    assert x.ndim == residual.ndim == 2 and x.shape == residual.shape
+    assert x.stride(-1) == residual.stride(-1) == 1
+    assert (next_weight is None) == (next_eps is None)
+    hidden = torch.empty(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(hidden) if next_weight is not None else None
+    n = x.shape[-1]
+    if hidden.numel():
+        _norm_residual_norm_kernel[(x.shape[0],)](
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_weight,
+            next_weight,
+            hidden,
+            normalized,
+            n,
+            x.stride(0),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            post_eps,
+            next_eps or 0.0,
+            *scales,
+            next_weight is not None,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(n),
+            num_warps=4 if n <= 1024 else 8,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return hidden, normalized
